observations: Owner reports that an ID 249 stack added by the editor does not appear in the in-game inventory.
The native table places ID 249 in the sepith group (type 0x0080), with a placeholder description.
excluded_inventory_entries.decision: Exclude from the addable item catalog and reject positive inventory writes. Read and preserve existing entries; allow explicit removal with quantity 0. Do not edit resource balances.
excluded_inventory_entries.limits: This is an unsupported-inventory-entry exclusion, not a verified icon mapping or an implementation of resource-counter editing.

confirmed_item_groups.method: The owner confirms one shared inventory icon for all 25 stock fish. Kasagin and Sky Gill are individually visible in screenshots. The other 23 mappings rely on the owner confirmation; no inference from biological size, name, or arbitrary ID subranges. Reserved IDs 2125–2129 and custom fish IDs are excluded.
